expected.insightNarrative:
Supply Chain is the RWFD Supply Chain Dashboard: four KPI tiles (orders per customer, total orders, average order weight and average units per order), carrier utilization, service level attainment, and five rankings of the plants by orders, unit quantity, order weight, ship-ahead days and ship-late days. Clicking a carrier name in Carrier Utilization filters the dashboard to that carrier. The story is a supply chain that runs through one plant: PLANT03 takes the bulk of the orders, units and weight, and also most of the early and late shipments.

Key insights
- PLANT03 dominates every plant ranking: 8,541 of the 9,215 orders, 28,611,617 units (96.94% of the total), 135,487 kg of order weight (73.99%), 15,479 ship-ahead days (90.68%) and 345 ship-late days (93.75%).
- On average, PLANT09 ships furthest ahead of schedule at 4.583 days per order, while PLANT08 ships closest to schedule at 0.706 days.
- Carrier V444_0 is used the most, at 68.0% of shipments.
- Service levels are mixed: DTP exceeded its service level attainment at 67.5%, DTD met it, and CRF missed it at 9.3%.
- Customers place about 200 orders each on average; the average order weighs 19.9 kg and contains 3,203 units.
